physicalNotes: Radius 0.25729369 Jupiter radii from Sulis et al. 2024 (2024A&A...688A..14S), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...688A..14S/abstract): 18,394.4 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. No mass is measured: Sulis et al. 2024 (2024A&A...688A..14S), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...688A..14S/abstract) gives only an upper limit of 0.03297377 Jupiter masses, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
